sets.name: Avatar
sets.desc: The avatar is a visual representation of a user, commonly displayed in profiles, comments, or messaging apps, enhancing user engagement and recognition.

sets.name: Avatar Group
sets.desc: Avatar groups come in two forms: the stacked version, where avatars are positioned one on top of the other without gaps, and the unstacked version, where there is space between each avatar.
